summary: Fixes a third latent gap r0031 surfaced: capture_phase_d_component assumed a binding.json (release_id/previous_release_id/previous_generation) already existed in .staging/attestations-<slot>/, but the real system never writes one -- only per-signer signatures. Now derives it deterministically from the committed deploy/releases/ chain, with a cryptographically-proven fixed constant for generation 1 (predates the protected_runtime manifest field). No protected-runtime change.
